title: Snake holding a balloon
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox='0 0 100 100'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="balloonGrad" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff9ec4"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ff3d7f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c81e5a"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d="M 62 25 Q 58 38 52 48 Q 47 57 44 64" fill="none" stroke="#ffe08a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="19" rx="13" ry="15" fill="url(#balloonGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="13" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ffd0e2" opacity="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="60,33 66,33 63,37" fill="#c81e5a"/>

  <!-- snake body coiling -->
  <path d="M 44 64 Q 36 72 40 80 Q 44 88 54 87 Q 66 86 68 78 Q 70 71 62 69 Q 54 67 52 74 Q 51 80 58 80"
        fill="none" stroke="#3fd27a" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 44 64 Q 36 72 40 80 Q 44 88 54 87 Q 66 86 68 78 Q 70 71 62 69 Q 54 67 52 74 Q 51 80 58 80"
        fill="none" stroke="#8ef0b4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- spot markings on body -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="76" r="2.2" fill="#1e7a45"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="85" r="2.2" fill="#1e7a45"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="85" r="2.2" fill="#1e7a45"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="76" r="2.2" fill="#1e7a45"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="71" r="2" fill="#1e7a45"/>

  <!-- snake head -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="59" rx="10" ry="8.5" fill="#3fd27a" transform="rotate(-20 42 59)"/>
  <!-- head lighter top -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="55" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8ef0b4" transform="rotate(-20 40 55)" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="56" r="2.6" fill="#ffe94d"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="58" r="2.6" fill="#ffe94d"/>
  <ellipse cx="40.5" cy="56.5" rx="1" ry="2.2" fill="#1a3a28"/>
  <ellipse cx="47.5" cy="58.5" rx="1" ry="2.2" fill="#1a3a28"/>

  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d="M 34 64 Q 28 67 25 65 M 28 67 Q 25 70 22 69" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
